# Results


From
`r format(lubridate::floor_date(study_period[1L], "month"), "%B %Y")`
to
`r format(lubridate::floor_date(study_period[2L], "month"), "%B %Y")`,
a total of `r n_agcs["initial"]` canisters were deployed
of which
`r n_agcs["final"]` were selected for desorption
covering `r n_cases_balanced` inhalational anaesthesia cases
(Figure\ \@ref(fig:agc-flowchart); Table\ \@ref(tab:table-one)).

Desorption of all analysed canisters was performed on
`r format(zeosys_desorption_date, "%d %B %Y")`.
ZeoSys recovered
`r zeosys_sevo_weight_kg` kg (`r zeosys_sevo_volume_l` L)
of sevoflurane
with a purity exceeding `r zeosys_purity_pct`%.
Sevoflurane accounted for
`r round(zeosys_yield * 100, 1)`%
of the canisters’ weight gain.
The remaining `r round((1 - zeosys_yield) * 100, 1)`%
were water (and only traces of metabolic products as e.g. acetone, Compound A-E).
The `r n_agcs["final"]` analysed canisters accounted for an estimated
`r round(n_bottles["final"], 1)` bottles
(`r round(sevo_final_kg, 1)` kg).
Relative to this subset, the recovered `r round(zeosys_sevo_weight_kg, 1)` kg
corresponded to a capture efficiency of `r round(recovery_pct_final, 1)`%.
Pre-desorption weights were taken `r zeosys_storage_days` days before desorption.
During this storage period,
canisters lost a median of `r round(abs(zeosys_med_wdiff_g), 1)` g
(`r round(zeosys_wdiff_pct_of_gain, 1)`% of the median weight gain).
This corresponds to a total storage loss of `r round(zeosys_total_wloss_g, 0)` g
across all `r n_agcs["final"]` canisters.
Figure\ \@ref(fig:weight-gain-distribution) shows the distribution of weight gain.

```{r agc-flowchart, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, dev = ifelse_is_docx("tiff", "png"), fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5, fig.cap = "Flow diagram of anaesthetic gas canisters from study sites to analysis. AGC, anaesthetic gas canister; OR, operating room."}
library("consort")

count_ors <- function(ids) length(unique(agcs$or[agcs$agc.id %in% ids]))
fmt       <- function(ids) paste0("n = ", length(ids), "; ", count_ors(ids), " ORs")
excl      <- function(reason)
    agcs$agc.id[!is.na(agcs$exclusion.reason) & agcs$exclusion.reason == reason]

all_ids   <- agcs$agc.id
excl1_ids <- excl("poor documentation")
excl2_ids <- excl("less than 10 cases")
excl3_ids <- excl("lost")
excl4_ids <- excl("outlier")
step1_ids <- agcs$agc.id[agcs$exclusion.reason %in% c("outlier") |
                          is.na(agcs$exclusion.reason)]
final_ids <- agcs$agc.id[is.na(agcs$exclusion.reason)]

p <- add_box(txt = paste0("AGCs used\n", fmt(all_ids)))
p <- add_side_box(p, side = "right", txt = paste0(
    "Excluded (n = ", length(c(excl1_ids, excl2_ids, excl3_ids)), ")",
    "\n- Poor documentation (n = ", length(excl1_ids), ")",
    "\n- Less than 10 cases (n = ", length(excl2_ids), ")",
    "\n- Not available at ZeoSys (n = ", length(excl3_ids), ")"
))
p <- add_box(p, txt = paste0("AGCs eligible\n", fmt(step1_ids)))
p <- add_side_box(p, side = "right", txt = paste0(
    "- Not selected (n = ", length(excl4_ids), ")"
))
p <- add_box(p, txt = paste0("AGCs selected for desorption\n", fmt(final_ids)))

p <- add_label_box(p, txt = c("1" = "Study sites", "2" = "ZeoSys", "3" = "Analysis"))

plot(p, grViz = !is_docx_output())
```

```{r table-one, echo = FALSE}
t1_data <- agcs[is.na(agcs$exclusion.reason), ]

## derived per-canister variables
n_inha_cols       <- grep("^n\\.cases.*inha", names(t1_data), value = TRUE)
n_tiva_cols       <- grep("^n\\.cases.*tiva", names(t1_data), value = TRUE)
t1_data$pct.ba    <- rowSums(t1_data[, n_inha_cols, drop = FALSE]) /
                     t1_data$n.cases * 100
t1_data$pct.tiva2 <- rowSums(t1_data[, n_tiva_cols, drop = FALSE]) /
                     t1_data$n.cases * 100
t1_data$pct.tube2 <- t1_data$pct.tube * 100
t1_data$pct.lap2  <- t1_data$pct.lap  * 100

## formatting helpers
med_iqr <- function(x, d = 1) {
    x <- x[!is.na(x)]
    if (!length(x)) return("—")
    sprintf("%s [%s–%s]",
            formatC(median(x),         digits = d, format = "f"),
            formatC(quantile(x, 0.25), digits = d, format = "f"),
            formatC(quantile(x, 0.75), digits = d, format = "f"))
}
n_pct <- function(x) {
    n   <- sum(x == 1L, na.rm = TRUE)
    tot <- sum(!is.na(x))
    sprintf("%d (%d%%)", n, round(n / tot * 100))
}

## build one column per group
centres  <- sort(unique(t1_data$center))
grp_dfs  <- c(
    list(Overall = t1_data),
    setNames(lapply(centres, function(ctr) t1_data[t1_data$center == ctr, ]),
             paste("Centre", centres))
)

make_col <- function(df) c(
    paste0("n = ", nrow(df)),
    med_iqr(df$n.cases,    d = 0),
    med_iqr(df$pct.ba,     d = 0),
    med_iqr(df$pct.tiva2,  d = 0),
    med_iqr(df$sum.dur,    d = 0),
    med_iqr(df$med.flow,   d = 1),
    med_iqr(df$pct.tube2,  d = 0),
    med_iqr(df$pct.lap2,   d = 0),
    n_pct(df$water.trap),
    med_iqr(df$weight.gain,                  d = 0),
    med_iqr(df$proportional.recaptured.sevo, d = 1)
)

row_labels <- c(
    "",
    "Cases per canister",
    "Inhalational anaesthesia, %",
    "TIVA, %",
    "Total anaesthesia duration, min",
    "Median fresh gas flow, l.min⁻¹",
    "Tracheal tube, %",
    "Laparoscopic surgery, %",
    "Water trap, n (%)",
    "Weight gain, g",
    "Estimated recaptured sevoflurane, g"
)

t1_mat <- do.call(cbind, lapply(grp_dfs, make_col))
t1_df  <- data.frame(Variable = row_labels, t1_mat,
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

knitr::kable(
    t1_df,
    col.names = c("", names(grp_dfs)),
    row.names = FALSE,
    caption   = paste0(
        "Characteristics of the ", n_agcs["final"], " analysed canisters, ",
        "overall and by centre. ",
        "Continuous variables: Median [Q1–Q3]; water trap: n (%). "
    )
)
```

Each point represents one canister. Colour indicates the participating centre; filled circles denote canisters equipped with a water trap, open circles those without. The dashed horizontal line marks the median weight gain.')}

```{r penalized-regression-setup, include = FALSE, cache = TRUE}
set.seed(20260517)

final_agcs <- agcs[!agcs$excluded, ]
num_cols   <- vapply(final_agcs, is.numeric, NA)
final_agcs[num_cols][is.na(final_agcs[num_cols])] <- 0

X <- model.matrix(
    proportional.recaptured.sevo
        ~ 0 +
        n.cases.lama.nonlap.tiva +
        n.cases.tube.nonlap.tiva +
        n.cases.tube.lap.tiva +
        n.cases.lama.nonlap.inha +
        n.cases.tube.nonlap.inha +
        n.cases.tube.lap.inha +
        sum.dur.lama.nonlap.tiva +
        sum.dur.tube.nonlap.tiva +
        sum.dur.tube.lap.tiva +
        sum.dur.lama.nonlap.inha +
        sum.dur.tube.nonlap.inha +
        sum.dur.tube.lap.inha +
        med.flow.lama.nonlap.tiva +
        med.flow.tube.nonlap.tiva +
        med.flow.tube.lap.tiva +
        med.flow.lama.nonlap.inha +
        med.flow.tube.nonlap.inha +
        med.flow.tube.lap.inha +
        water.trap,
        data = final_agcs
)
Y <- final_agcs$proportional.recaptured.sevo

fit <- rcv.glmnet(
    X, Y,
    alpha = 1, intercept = FALSE, nfolds = nfolds, nrepcv = nrepcv
)
```

```{r stabsel-results, include = FALSE, cache = TRUE, dependson = "penalized-regression-setup"}
library("stabs")
set.seed(20260517)
pi_thr <- 0.8

## fitfun wrapping rcv.glmnet: stability selection on top of repeated CV
rcv_glmnet_fitfun <- function(x, y, q, ...) {
    fit <- ameld::rcv.glmnet(
        x, y,
        alpha     = 1,
        intercept = FALSE,
        nfolds    = nfolds,
        nrepcv    = nrepcv,
        pmax      = q,
        trace.it  = FALSE
    )
    cf       <- as.matrix(coef(fit, s = "lambda.1se"))
    cf       <- cf[rownames(cf) != "(Intercept)", , drop = FALSE]
    selected <- cf[, 1] != 0
    names(selected) <- colnames(x)
    path <- as.matrix(fit$glmnet.fit$beta != 0)
    list(selected = selected, path = path)
}

stab_fit <- stabsel(
    x             = X,
    y             = Y,
    fitfun        = rcv_glmnet_fitfun,
    cutoff        = pi_thr,
    PFER          = pfer,
    B             = 100,
    sampling.type = "MB"
)

stab_df <- data.frame(
    variable = names(stab_fit$max),
    max.prob = round(stab_fit$max, 3),
    selected = ifelse(names(stab_fit$max) %in% names(stab_fit$selected), "Yes", "No"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
stab_df <- stab_df[order(-stab_df$max.prob), ]
rownames(stab_df) <- NULL

stab_selected_vars <- names(stab_fit$selected)
```

```{r penalized-regression-prose, include = FALSE}
coef_min <- as.matrix(coef(fit, s = "lambda.min"))
coef_1se <- as.matrix(coef(fit, s = "lambda.1se"))

nonzero_min <- rownames(coef_min)[coef_min[, 1] != 0]
nonzero_1se <- rownames(coef_1se)[coef_1se[, 1] != 0]

ncases_inha_min <- nonzero_min[grepl("n\\.cases.*inha", nonzero_min)]
wt_coef_min     <- coef_min["water.trap", 1]
```

Of the `r ncol(X)` candidate predictors entered into a LASSO model to predict
the amount of recaptured sevoflurane,
`r length(nonzero_min)` retained non-zero coefficients at lambda.min and
`r length(nonzero_1se)` at the more parsimonious lambda.1se
(Table\ \@ref(tab:penalized-regression-coef)).
Predictors consistently selected were
median fresh gas flow during inhalational anaesthesia cases,
`r ifelse(length(ncases_inha_min) > 0, "the number of inhalational anaesthesia cases,", "")`
and water trap use.
`r ifelse(wt_coef_min > 0, "Water trap use was associated with higher recapture.", "Water trap use was associated with lower recapture.")`
All predictors related exclusively to TIVA cases were reduced to zero by the penalisation.

```{r stabsel-prose, include = FALSE}
stab_top <- head(stab_df[order(-stab_df$max.prob), ], 2)
```

In stability selection
(PFER ≤ `r pfer`; Online Supplementary File S1, Table\ \@ref(tab:stabsel-table)),
the only stably selected predictor was
the median fresh gas flow during inhalational anaesthesia cases performed
with a tracheal tube and in non-laparoscopic surgery
(maximum selection probability `r format(round(stab_top$max.prob[1L], 2), nsmall = 2)`).
The corresponding case count in the same subgroup approached
the effective selection probability threshold but did not cross it
(`r format(round(stab_top$max.prob[2L], 2), nsmall = 2)`).
All remaining predictors fell well below the threshold.
The stability-selection finding therefore corroborates the broad LASSO signal:
fresh gas flow under inhalational anaesthesia is the most robust candidate predictor
of per-canister loading.
The role of the other predictors remains uncertain at the present sample size.

```{r penalized-regression-coef, echo = FALSE}
knitr::kable(
    as.matrix(cbind(coef(fit, s = "lambda.min"), coef(fit, s = "lambda.1se"))),
    col.names = c("lambda.min", "lambda.1se"),
    digits = 4,
    caption = "LASSO coefficients (lambda.min and lambda.1se) for the prediction of recaptured sevoflurane weight (g) from anaesthesia case characteristics."
)
```
